column1: # The 23 role tokens of manifests/transitions.json (_meta.role_tokens) as parameters of one shape. One row per (token, way of holding it).
# shape: seat (seat.py: an offer and an acceptance) | row (read off the row judged) | tally (a count, not standing) | none (does not reduce, or the text names no row).

# conferrer: self:holder (the key signs for itself, one row) | self:object (the object's own key confers) | seat:<scope> (under a live seat of that scope) | group (a count over the head named; the policy row is in `policy`).
# consent: same_row | accept_row | one (waived by the text) | unstated (the text states no acceptance row; run with one).
# ends: withdraw:conferrer | withdraw:holder | upstream (the seat it is under ends) | unseat:<policy row> (a counted cut) | unseat:self | lapse (a window, not a row).

# fits: yes (runs as an instance with every parameter stated) | partly (runs; a parameter is unstated or something beside the seat is needed) | no. cc_ref and DISAGREE notes are carried from roles/role_definitions.tsv.

column13: note

Same seat as moderate with another scope and root. The text states the conferral and the holder's own withdrawal, and no acceptance row. The tables spell the token infra:attest_assurance, the text assure:age and assure:capacity.
Read off the row judged: its signer. It is the object's own key of a self-rooted seat over that row, so an author's delegate is seat conf=seat under it.
The retired row lists the custodian; no acceptance by the custodian is stated (listed, not delegated).

Counted over two different seats (the operator and the Wise Authority), not over the live seats of one scope; run here over one body of three. The row that seats the successor is also the cut on the predecessor.
One row is offer and acceptance: listed and signed. Holds member and the duties at zero hops (HOLDS).
The text states the promoted member's consent and names no row and no count.
Same seat as member over another object. The seating objects (accord_proposal, participation) are outside the 184 families, so the acceptance is not a stated row.
Same seat as registered with a label as scope. DISAGREE carried: the text seats a detector by delegation (infra:detect under a trust root), which is the attest row.
Same seat as registered with a label as scope. DISAGREE carried: the text requires infra:attest from the node's owner, which is the infra:attest row.
Conferred under the owner seat; the node's cosignature on the binding is the acceptance. Narrowing only: a child scope never satisfies a check for its parent.
The attest row with another scope. On the ceremony plane the edge is a cosignature counted over the conferring roster (conf=group), not a delegation.
Two walks meet at the key: the counted widening and the joiner's acceptance. The widening names the acceptance. A guest seat also lapses at valid_until (a row stating its own end).
The one seat with a single consent (a node has no agency): the acceptance is waived by the parameter, never under conf=seat.

The delegated seat. review, slash and takedown are this row with another scope; attest, infra:attest and wa are this row with another scope and root. No acceptance row is stated. The lapse by silence is a window, not a row.
No row: the founder seat holds the duty at zero hops (HOLDS). Run as the founder seat read for scope moderate.
The count is the ranked tally (the winner token) and the acceptance is ballot:moderator_acceptance. DISAGREE carried: CC 4.5.4 says the election emits a delegation, CC 4.5.13 seats on the acceptance.

column6: the agent's key, then the custodian
column13: The preserve_request names the operator; that an operator may decline is said, the accepting row and the ending are not.

column5: a node key or an agent key
column13: Two signatures: the owner's binding and the owned key's cosignature. Which is offer and which acceptance is a naming choice; here the owned key confers. Single-valued: read with the `one` reducer, two live owners is none. Withdrawal by the owned key needs a quorum finding (a guard, not a second edge).
The owner row over a minor. Whether the minor's key cosigns is not stated; a displacement by court order is counted over the people it binds.
Read off the grant's envelope (owner_key_id). No row is named that makes a key the owner of a blob.
A walk of one self-signed row. Who may sign a revocation of another's key is not stated; run here as the key's own.
= moderate (appointed) with scope review. Recusal is a guard on the act.

column13: Read off the row judged.

column2: a roster key of one self
column13: Same seat as member over another object. Whether the added key signs is not stated. The lone path of the eviction is a window (window.py). The transitions table opens the revocation to nobody.

Two seats that must both hold: the node's member seat and a live owner seat over the node. One stands() does not say it; it is an `and` of two, which is the `may` answer. DISAGREE carried: CC 3.4.7 reads it as a delegation under a trust root.
= moderate (appointed) with scope slash. DISAGREE carried: the transitions table opens slashing to any registered key.
The owner row under a second name (HOLDS: owner holds steward).
The reader confers and the root's own charter is the acceptance; the offer names the acceptance. This seat is the root of the attest walk. DISAGREE carried (naming): the text never calls it steward.
No family or row is named for naming a community steward.
Read off the row judged: its signed subject_key_ids. A subject's delegate is seat conf=seat under it.
= moderate (appointed) with scope takedown.
Self-rooted over a row: the conferrer is read off the row (subject). No acceptance row is stated.

column6: the roster and a group secret
column13: A member seat and then a draw from a secret that is not a row. A node outside the group cannot evaluate it, so it is not a function of rows.
The scope is resolve_deferral or resolve_deferral:{domain}. The text states the conferral and both withdrawals and no acceptance row.
= moderate (appointed) with another scope and root: conferred under the owner seat. Which member of the row names the agent is not stated.
No family seats a key in the designated body. DISAGREE carried within the text.
Not standing: the ranked count over the ballots, then a window. It is the count of the group conferrer of the elected moderate seat.
